item_short_desc: Rothco’s Window Punch is an essential tool for emergency responders, police, EMS, or civilians needing quick action in emergency situations. Designed with a spring-loaded mechanism, the punch delivers powerful impact to break glass efficiently. The hardened steel point ensures reliable performance, while the adjustable tension lets you customize the punch force to your needs. Crafted from lightweight, corrosion-resistant aluminum, the barrel features a knurled finish for a secure grip in high-pressure moments.
